newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns K-1 to Sweden's Vasakronan.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns K-1 to Sweden's Vasakronan.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Friday it assigned a K-1 rating to the three billion-crown commercial paper programme of Swedish state property company Vasakronan.

Vasakronan has 3.3 million square metres of floor space. "The rating action primarily reflects the high quality of Vasakronan's property portfolio, the geographic diversification, the customer base and a contract lease portfolio well spread over time," S&P said.
Some 90 percent of Vasakronan's tenants are state authorities. Vasakronan is 100 percent state-owned.
S&P said a government decision to transfer various types of premises from the state-owned company Securum AB to Vasakronan was not expected to negatively impact the company's credit quality.
